hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Maintain distances for arriving at each node via a red edge versus a blue edge.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: From an edge of one color, only transition into adjacent edges of the opposite color.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Run breadth-first search initializing both red and blue arrivals from the source vertex.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search traverses 2V states across red and blue edge transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring incoming edge color causes invalid non-alternating path selections.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models edge color alternation with state-expanded breadth-first search.
